title: Second part of ASAP/ENRP dissector clean-ups
description:
Further clean-ups of the ASAP and ENRP dissectors:
- Reduces redundancy by moving common definitions into packet-asap+enrp-common.h
- Updated headers to use up-to-date I-D URLs

notes.body:
added 7 commits
  • d7a06d9b...fb3de6ef - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 80b723dc - Moved common definitions from packet-asap.c to packet-asap+enrp-common.h.
  • 957ab637 - Removed defines from packet-enrp.c, since they are now already defined in...
  • 57300b50 - Moved some more definitions.
  • eabca2f2 - Header updates, pointing to up-to-date I-D versions.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2256/diffs?diff_id=151540416&start_sha=d7a06d9befd1aaf68d1ced7ffc3fad3a0a2e4f41)
I couldn't merge this branch: Insufficient approvals (have: [] missing: 1)
